PDF export is separate from Page publishing unless the current platform explicitly supports it.

exampleAnswers.Purpose and audience: A community home with a welcoming path, recurring activities, and participation guidelines.
exampleAnswers.Working context: The fictional Side Project Circle is a small peer group for people building useful things outside their day jobs. Members choose a manageable next step and return to share what happened.
exampleAnswers.Example records:
Gathering: Monday check-in · Cadence: Weekly · Bring: One achievable intention
Gathering: Open work session · Cadence: Every other week · Bring: A task you can do together
Gathering: Demo afternoon · Cadence: Monthly · Bring: An example and a lesson
exampleAnswers.Content decisions:
Your first visit: Read the participation guide, introduce the project in a few sentences, and choose a gathering that fits. Listening is participation; nobody needs a polished presentation to attend.
How we look after the space: Give feedback on the work, ask before sharing someone else’s material, and keep private conversations private. The organizer should publish a clear reporting route and explain how concerns are handled.
Make room for newcomers: A rotating host welcomes first-time participants and explains the format. Keep event information current and offer a written recap for people who cannot attend live.
exampleAnswers.Format and interaction: directory layout; section navigation and expandable detail where useful; matching portrait document PDF.
exampleAnswers.Sharing and provenance: A hypothetical example informed by Claw Me’s small-team and Agent workflows. These are not Pete’s actual clients, finances, travel plans, research results, or commitments. Keep the real adaptation private until the owner chooses to share.
